messages:
support-oliver: FYI incoming customer escalations from several hosted tenants in nz1-az1 — spike in 502/504 + auth timeouts since ~08:10 NZT. Getting billing alerts too (retries). Investigating :rotating_light:
infra-oncall: Seeing increased gateway 502 rate in nz1-az1, p50 latency up from ~60ms → ~450ms, retransmit rate on egress interface ~2.2%.
observability-bot: Alert: hosted_api.gateway_5xx_rate (nz1-az1) > 1.5% for 5m (alert id: A-2026-092)
maria (sre): Can you paste top-line packet/retrans stats and BGP flaps? Any scheduled provider maintenance?
infra-oncall: Provider had a planned maintenance window for later but nothing started. BGP updates coincide with spike — see AS path withdraws to our NZ PoP. Quick tcpdump snippet from gw0 below showing ICMP TTL exceeded and retransmits:
```
14:02:13.123456 IP 10.0.0.1.50000 > 198.51.100.5.443: Flags [P.], seq 1:513, ack 1, win 229, length 512
14:02:13.123789 IP 198.51.100.5 > 10.0.0.1: ICMP time exceeded
14:02:13.124000 IP 10.0.0.1.50000 > 198.51.100.5.443: Flags [P.], seq 513:1025, ack 1
```
lex (eng-runtime): KVCACHE misses spiking as expected — long tail for some requests. We also see token validation failures on retries (clients exhaust retry budget then renew token causing auth errors). 5xx -> repeated retries -> auth noise and billing increases.
support-alex: Customers reporting unexpected billing spikes from automatic retry loops. Need repro steps and quick mitigations to share.
aj (netops): Quick mitigation: enable in-region fallback to nz1-az2 and shift a small canary of traffic. Pushing route-change now (prep: BGP local-preference tweak + withdraw less-preferred path).
infra-oncall: Canary traffic to nz1-az2 live — p50 for canary back to ~90ms, 5xx ~0.3%. Bulk on nz1-az1 still elevated.
maria (sre): Also recommend server-side short-circuit on 5xx for hosted tenants (stop aggressive automatic server retries) and advise customers to reduce client retries temporarily. We'll collect per-tenant retry counts for billing reconciliation.
support-oliver: Customer-facing guidance (to CS): temporarily disable aggressive client retries and, if possible, point traffic to nz1-az2 endpoint. We're coordinating with provider for a failover.
provider-liaison: Provider engineering acknowledges microburst on an undersea hop impacting nz1 egress; they are injecting alternate paths and will confirm BGP convergence timeline in ~5m.
infra-oncall: Rolling partial fallback to secondary transit now (local-preference bump for secondary next-hop). Monitoring error-rate/latency across gw0/gw1.
observability-bot: Update: hosted_api.gateway_5xx_rate (nz1-az1) down to 0.8% (5m window) for canary paths; p50 latency for canary 92ms.
support-alex: Drafted repro + mitigation steps for CS ticketing (paste into playbook):
```
1) curl -v https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" --data '{"prompt":"hello"}'
2) If you observe TCP resets / 502 / 504, try rerouting to nz1-az2 endpoint: https://nz1-az2.api.redwood.com (if available)
3) Reduce client retries to max 2 with exponential backoff (start 200ms)
4) If you control DNS / LB, shift a small % of traffic to nz1-az2 until provider reports stable paths
```
maria (sre): Postmortem checklist: collect pcaps from gw0/gw1, BGP update timeline, provider AS_PATH changes, per-tenant retry and billing spike logs, token validation timelines, and runtime kernel TCP stats.
support-oliver: I'm compiling a list of affected tenants and will push templated comms to CS. Please add affected tenant IDs to the doc.
cs-jen: Got it — prepping external comms and escalation notes.
infra-oncall: Provider completed reroute at 08:45 NZT; nz1-az1 error rate trending to normal. Keeping incident open for follow-up and billing reconciliation. :white_check_mark:
